title: gordonia ceylanica var. elliptica

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic effects and bioactive constituents.
